title: The Wind Phone
summary: A disconnected telephone in a Japanese garden where people speak to loved ones they have lost. What began as a personal space for grief became a place others could visit too.
thoughts: A life lost isn’t just a statistic. The consequences ripple through many other lives. It changed the way I think about Zero Lives Lost.

title: FloodNet NYC
summary: A community-engaged network of street-level sensors documenting urban flooding in New York City and making the observations accessible to residents, agencies and researchers.
thoughts: Interesting technology, but I wanted to see clearer evidence of what changes because the data exist. And I wouldn’t assume that an approach designed for New York would transfer easily to places with very different infrastructure.
